hard_gates: No contract passes without explicit compatibility, idempotency or retry behavior, concurrency semantics, validation and error shapes, authorization hooks, and a verified migration path with rollback or declared point of no return.
Review, reporting, contract, and audit candidates never imply implementation, live policy change, production mutation, or risk acceptance.

Identity remapping requires collision-free exact old and new identities, bounded provider scope, continuity plan, affected-resource inventory, verification, and rollback; renaming telemetry emitters is separate.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.

responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 2 related modes: Define versioned data schemas, invariants, migration and rollback, API shapes, validation, errors, pagination, idempotency, concurrency, compatibility, and authorization hooks before implementation.; Remap one telemetry service identity in one exact provider scope after collision, continuity, retention, dashboard, alert, and rollback checks under per-action authorization.
